scope_note: Independent visual review of receipts only. No integration, manifest, research or power changes. For each of the 5 requested slugs I viewed the native 1254px PNG, a 200px thumbnail, and targeted native crops: la-diablesse (face, both hands, hoof and foot, a 3x enlargement of the 200px, and comparison with attempt-02); maha-sona (both hands, head, legs, graveyard); majimun (underside and foot, head, rooster); na-ruixa (fairy face and both hands, sailor face and both hands, boat interior, comparison with attempt-02); nightmarchers (leader face, hands and hips, flanking warriors, all feet above the water, spear tips and butt, background). For the three edit corrections (la-diablesse, maha-sona, majimun) the PNG was also diffed against its edit_reference_file to confirm the changes stayed local. I compared each image against the receipt visual_requirements, the research claims (statements and source quotes) embedded in the ledger, and the earlier Claude correction notes (2118-r02/r04). Before writing, each PNG SHA-256 was recomputed and matched against the receipt native_sha256, the Codex visual_review hash, the ledger item hash and the Codex root native-review hash in drafts/root/codex-native-reviews.json. Claude wrote only root_visual_review and the receipt status, and synced only the ledger item status; each receipt and the ledger were re-read immediately before writing. No PNG, Codex visual_review, Codex native review or other receipt was modified. All 5 pass; limitations are recorded in each root_visual_review.
